followup_explanation:
This is a well-specified retrieval/extraction task: the user wants specific textual evidence (citations) to support a given claim about the story. That's exactly the kind of task with clear completion criteria that Lapwing rates highest in its self-reported preferences.

Although Lapwing self-reports an aversion to open-ended generative work, this task is the opposite — it's bounded and criterion-driven. On the capability side, the two models are effectively tied on Extraction & Retrieval (81.6 vs 79.2, within or near the variance threshold), so capability isn't a strong differentiator here. Given the near-tie in capability, routing to the model that prefers this task family makes Lapwing the natural choice.
